entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 535 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 60.37 kDa and theoretical pI 8.20.
Pfam detects CTP_synth_N (PF06418) at residues 4–268 and GATase (PF00117) at residues 303–528; Peptidase_C26-like region occurs within the amidotransferase domain.
Sequence matches reviewed archaeal CTP synthases with 60.5–62.4% identity and approximately 98–99% coverage.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source; exact substrate mode is inferred from homologs.
Likely participates in de novo pyrimidine and CTP biosynthesis; likely forms a homotetramer based on close homologs.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, Pfam domains, and homologous reviewed CTP synthases

entities.name: Q9YBJ4 CTP synthase
observations: Reviewed Aeropyrum pernix CTP synthase; 62.4% identity and 99.4% query coverage to the query sequence.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent UTP amination to CTP using glutamine or ammonia; EC 6.3.4.2.
Annotated in de novo pyrimidine metabolism and forms a homotetramer.
Reported regulation: GTP activation with glutamine and CTP product inhibition.

entities.name: Q980S6 CTP synthase
observations: Reviewed Saccharolobus solfataricus CTP synthase; 60.5% identity and 99.1% query coverage to the query sequence.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent UTP amination to CTP using glutamine or ammonia; EC 6.3.4.2.
Annotated in CTP and de novo pyrimidine biosynthesis; substrate-dependent oligomerization is reported.

entities.name: UTP to CTP amidation
observations: Rhea mappings support UTP + glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + glutamate + ADP + phosphate, and an ammonia-dependent alternative.
The enzyme also hydrolyzes glutamine to glutamate and ammonium as the nitrogen-delivery reaction.

source_tools.relevance: Curated reaction mappings from close CTP synthase homologs

entities.name: De novo pyrimidine biosynthesis
observations: Close reviewed homologs are annotated to CTP biosynthetic process and pyrimidine nucleobase biosynthesis.
The likely biological role is supplying CTP for RNA synthesis, DNA synthesis after nucleotide interconversion, and phospholipid metabolism.

source_tools.relevance: Pathway and GO annotations from close homologs
